_comment: THE AUTHOR'S RECORD, NOT A CONTRACT. Nothing in the plugin reads this file. A slot is a
pre-compiled binary whose class id, list entry and payload module name are all fixed, so it
needs nothing from here - it loads the module name it was built with, from the cartridge
directory, and that is the whole binding.
This exists so that YOU, and the tools in this kit, can answer questions the plugin has no
reason to ask: which cartridge is currently in which slot, what you meant to call it, which
lane it uses, and what it should be named when it is eventually sealed as a product.
name: @DISPLAY_NAME@
_requires: WHAT THIS CARTRIDGE WAS VERIFIED AGAINST. Required, and checked.
cartridges/ is a shared, crowdsourced library: somebody who did not write this will one day
download it and try to run it. These three facts are what tells them whether it can work -
which 3ds Max, which plugin version, and which slot hosts it. Without them a cartridge that
fails on their machine is indistinguishable from a cartridge that is broken.
They record what was TESTED, not what is hoped. Widen the list when you have run it there.
